description_en: Upgrades an approved text SMS signature to a 5G messaging signature
description_zh: 将已通过审核的文本短信签名升级为5G消息签名
name: UpgradeToRCSSignature

parameters.help_en: The signature name. The signature must be an existing and available text SMS signature
parameters.help_zh: 签名名称。需为已存在的可用文本短信签名
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en: The fileKey of the logo image. Obtain this value by uploading the image through the [GetOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~GetOSSInfoForUploadFile~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: Logo图片的 fileKey。通过[GetOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~GetOSSInfoForUploadFile~~)接口上传图片后获取
parameters.name: logo

parameters.help_en: The service phone number. Chinese characters are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 服务电话。不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: service_phone

parameters.help_en: The service email address. Chinese characters are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 服务邮箱。不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: service_email

parameters.help_en: The service website URL. The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 服务官网URL。必须以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: service_website

parameters.help_en: The terms of service URL. The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 服务条款URL。必须以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: service_terms

parameters.example: No.XX, XX Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou
parameters.help_en: The office address. Square brackets in Chinese or English are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 办公地址。不能包含中英文中括号
parameters.name: office_address

parameters.help_en: The bubble color. The format is `#rrggbb`
parameters.name: bubble_color

parameters.help_en: The fileKey of the background image. Obtain this value by uploading the image through the [GetOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~GetOSSInfoForUploadFile~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 背景图片的 fileKey。通过[GetOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~GetOSSInfoForUploadFile~~)接口上传图片后获取
parameters.name: background_image

parameters.help_en: The description. English double quotation marks, backslashes, or emojis are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 描述信息。不可包含英文双引号、反斜杠或 emoji
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The longitude of the address location. The value is in numeric format with up to 3 decimal places
parameters.help_zh: 地址位置经度。数字格式，小数点后最多3位
parameters.name: longitude

parameters.help_en: The latitude of the address location. The value is in numeric format with up to 3 decimal places
parameters.help_zh: 地址位置纬度。数字格式，小数点后最多3位
parameters.name: latitude
